      public EnOceanDeviceImpl(org.osgi.framework.BundleContext bundleContext, EnOceanBaseDriver driver, int uid, int rorg)
      An EnOceanDeviceImpl creation is directly related to its registration within the framework. Such a Device should only be registered after a proper teach-in procedure, so that the RORG, FIUNC and TYPE are already known.
